title: catalyst journal verify
description: What `catalyst journal verify --json` prints: whether the journal holds (hash chains, blobs, pins, files changed since their last entry), and each issue (catalyst >= 0.95.0 describes it). Notes are left out. `ok` is false when an issue is an error, or any issue with `--strict`.

at.description: `<journal file>:<line>`; empty when about the journal as a whole.

legacy.description: About an entry the catalyst CLI did not write.

path.description: The file the issue is about, when it is about one.
